purpose: Keep Remotion templates aligned with frontend-grade visual and motion standards instead of one-off demo styling.

principles.rule: Every movement must explain hierarchy, causality, focus, or narrative timing.
principles.avoid: Decorative looping motion that only makes the frame feel busy.

principles.rule: Colors, type, radius, shadows, spacing, and motion curves must come from shared tokens.
principles.avoid: Hardcoded neon gradients, arbitrary box shadows, or one-off spring configs inside each template.

principles.rule: Prefer calm surfaces, precise contrast, visible structure, and one strong accent color.
principles.avoid: Large glowing cards, many saturated accents, and decorative radial backgrounds.

principles.rule: Chinese text must use a readable CJK font fallback, tight hierarchy, and line heights designed for video.
principles.avoid: Inter/Arial-only text stacks or oversized text without a clear role.

principles.rule: Important text and controls stay inside a 64-96px safe area, with stable dimensions across frames.
principles.avoid: Elements that resize, drift, or collide with captions/progress overlays.

principles.rule: Judge templates by stills at 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100 percent of duration, not by code alone.
principles.avoid: Shipping a component because the code looks clever while the rendered frame looks cheap.

fontStack.sans: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Arial, sans-serif
fontStack.serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

DocumentReveal: Use archive/editorial paper geometry with restrained texture.
Camera motion should be a slow documentary push, not a zoom punch.
Highlight animation should guide the eye without covering the text.
QuoteReveal: Treat quotes like an editorial pull quote with source metadata.
Reveal text with staggered opacity/position and one accent line.
Keep background quiet enough for long Chinese text.
ConceptDiagram: Prefer structured flows, layers, stacks, or timelines over generic radial node diagrams.
Animate relationship lines before detail labels.
Use labels as explanatory objects, not decorative bubbles.
ThreeD: Define camera, lighting, material, and subject semantics before adding particles.
Use primitives only when they represent a real concept in the scene.
